Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a complete white-out of the left hemithorax with the mediastinum (trachea and heart) shifted to the right, away from the affected side. This ipsilateral opacity with contralateral mediastinal shift is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion (or pyopneumothorax as stated in the history), which exerts mass effect pushing structures to the opposite side, whereas lung collapse would pull the mediastinum toward the opacity.
